subtitle: Pull specific pages out of a PDF into a new file.

options.hint: Click the pages you want to keep.
options.confirmHint: Only the selected pages will be included in the new file.

howItWorks.title: How to extract pages from a PDF
steps: Upload the PDF file you want to extract from.
Click each page you want to keep.
Click Extract and download the new PDF.

items.a: Yes, extracting pages is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Can I extract more than one page?
items.a: Yes, select as many pages as you like before clicking Extract.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
